description: Fetch a setlist.fm artist record by band name or MusicBrainz ID. Pass `artist_name` ("Radiohead") and the name is resolved to the MBID for you, preferring an exact match so a tribute act does not answer for the band; pass `mbid` directly when you already have one. Returns artist name, MBID, Ticketmaster ID, sort name, and disambiguation info.

artist_name.description: Band or performer name, e.g. "Radiohead". Either this or mbid is required.

mbid.description: MusicBrainz ID, e.g. "a74b1b7f-71a5-4011-9441-d0b5e4122711". Either this or artist_name is required.

name: artist
title: Artist
